newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MTBE jumps 1.50 cents on refiner demand.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MTBE jumps 1.50 cents on refiner demand.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices jumped nearly 1.50 cents in moderate Friday activity as refiners picked up barrels for blending with reformulated gasoline, players said.
For the past month, tight supplies combined with high refinery run rates, which has increased RFG output, has put a tough premium on prompt barrels of MTBE.
"You name it and that refinery has been out there in the market," said a Houston MTBE broker.
On the U.S. Gulf Coast, spot Houston MTBE traded for 92.00 cents, up one cent from Thursday.
On the East Coast, New York Harbor spot MTBE was notionally up 1.50 cents to between 95.00/96.00 cents.
The latest American Petroleum Institute report showed refinery rates at 95.6 pct of capacity for the week ended July 4, 1997.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 1212 859-1631--
